evidence.quote: Applicants with certificates issued abroad must apply for a VPD certificate from uni-assist via the HSBI application portal before applying.

name.fr: Preuve de la qualification d'entrée à l'université (originaux et traductions certifiées)
Copie de la convention de coopération

evidence.quote: Please upload the application documents listed below to the university’s application portal: Proof of university entrance qualification (originals and certified translations into German or English produced by sworn translators), The VPD certificate from uni-assist (see step 4), In case of access to the university through TestAS or ITB test: preliminary review documentation (VPD) from uni-assist (for Studienkolleg) and TestAS or ITB result, Recognised language certificate, Copy of the cooperation agreement*

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states "Tuition fees per semester None" for this programme, so amountMinor 0 (no tuition fees); the general semester contribution (approx. 230 EUR per semester on the DAAD page) is not a tuition fee. Application channel: the VPD/uni-assist sentence is on the HSBI work-integrated programmes page (the DAAD page mentions uni-assist only in a nav label, "Submit application via • uni-assist • Website", without a sentence). The intake deadline was left out: the general "For the winter semester: until 15 July" / "1 December and 15 July" statements are general and the latter is framed for work-integrated programmes, not clearly for this specific programme with a year; no year is given. The listed documents are from the general "work-integrated study programmes" guide; they are not confirmed programme-specific for Mechatronics and Automation, though the DAAD page describes this programme's work-integrated variant. Chinese, Vietnamese or Indian applicants additionally need an APS certificate (not applicable to a Moroccan applicant).

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre diplôme étranger vous donne accès à ce cursus (bases de données DAAD/anabin) et si vous devez obtenir un certificat VPD auprès d'uni-assist via le portail de candidature HSBI.
note.en: Check whether your foreign certificate qualifies you for this programme (DAAD/anabin databases) and whether you must obtain a VPD certificate from uni-assist via the HSBI application portal.

evidence.quote: Please check DAAD’s admissions database to see whether your foreign certificates entitle you to study your desired subject at a German university.
